question: One diagonal of a parallelogram is 70 cm and the distance of this diagonal from either of the outlying vertices is 27 cm. The area of the parallelogram is:
solution:
Given:

One diagonal of a parallelogram is 70 cm and the perpendicular distance is 27 cm

Formula used:

Area of triangle = (1/2 × Base × Height) sq. unit

Calculations:

Let ABCD is a parallelogram and AC =70 cm and draw DM and BL perpendicular to AC

 [IMAGE: https:https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1cfc79f75a55f42087d059c8faea7fb99a8a57308cc48d3ec766a53a5e9bcc.png] 

⇒ DM = BL = 27 cm

Area of parallelogram = ar(Δ ABC) + ar(Δ ACD)

⇒ (1/2 × 70 × 27) + (1/2 × 70 × 27)

⇒ 945 + 945

⇒ 1890 cm2

∴ Required area of parallelogram is 1890 cm2
